name: Dr. John Brittas
education: B.A., M.A., M. Phil., Ph.D. Educated at Calicut University, Kerala and Jawaharlal Nehru University, Delhi
profession: Senior Journalist, Media top management Personnel
permanent_address: No.10-B, K.G.S, Greens Apartments, Kowdiar, Golf Links Road, Thiruvananthapuram. 695003
books: In Malayalam, (i) Chillujalakakkoottil, 2015, (ii) Innocent Samsarikkunnu, 2015, (iii) Malayalathinte Manavikatha, 2012, (iv) Sthreeparvam, 2009 and (v) Marayillathe, 2006
social_activities: Writing; hosted several television programms - Question Time, Cross Fire, Nammal Thamil, JB Junction, Njan Malayalee, Votograph, etc; acted in a couple of Malayalam movies including a hero role; recipient of, (i) Journalism Education Award from Goenka Foundation for research on "The Impact of Globalization in Print Media" and (ii) Kerala State Award for Best Anchor and Presenter during three years; numerous other television journalist/presenter awards
hobbies: Member, Press Club of India; badminton
countries_visited: Widely travelled; accompanied the Prime Minister, Dr. Manmohan Singh to U.S.A. and Russia, as a member of the Media delegation team; Iraq, to cover the news of US-Iraq war and was the first journalist from India to reach Baghdad; Pakistan, to cover the general elections; Nepal, to cover the general elections soon after the death of King Birendra; U.K., Germany, South Africa, Switzerland, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Syria, U.A.E., Kuwait, Qatar, Sultanate of Oman, Bahrain, Egypt, etc.
other_information: First rank holder and recipient of Gold medal in Master's Degree; was University Union Councillor, Sree Kerala Varma College, Thrissur, Kerala; started career as a journalist in 1987 at Kannur, Kerala and thereafter in New Delhi; Journalist in Delhi from 1988 to 2003; Managing Director and Chief Editor, Malayalam Communications Ltd. (Kairali T.V.); Former Business Head, Asianet Communications; Director, (i) Indian Broadcasting & Digital Foundation (since 2018) and (ii) Kerala Television Federation; contributed to regional and national publications; covered Indian Parliament news for more than a decade; Journalist, Central Hall and long and distinguished Pass holder; covered important events like Babri Masjid demolition, Gujarat riots, Gujarat earthquake, general elections, etc.

positions.position: Member, India- Vietnam Parliamentary Friendship Group
Member, Committee on Transport, Tourism & Culture
Member, Consultative Committee for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Member, Committee on Communications and Information Technology
Member, Committee on Information and Communication Technology Management in Rajya Sabha
Member, Telephone Advisory Committee for Trivandrum, Kerala
Advisor to Chief Minister of Kerala
